walk_forward.method: expanding chronological forecasts; each game uses only strictly earlier completed games
walk_forward.baseline: mean NBA game total over the preceding 90 days (or all prior games when unavailable)

release_reason: Not qualified: require at least 100 unseen forecast games with lower MAE than baseline and absolute bias <=3 points, plus at least 100 settled, immutable, fresh SportyBet market-225 holdout bets with positive ROI, a positive 95% lower confidence bound, and ROI above the market-favourite baseline.
